{{Quote|My own lightsaber. Until now, lost to me... but through your great power in the Force, I have found it. You must claim it.|Aloysius Kallig|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Kallig's lightsaber''' was the weapon used by the ancient [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Aloysius Kallig]], a contemporary of [[Tulak Hord]]. After the Sith Lord's demise, the lightsaber was entrusted to the [[Escalus line|Escalus family]]. Those wardens had to keep the weapon until an heir of Aloysius Kallig came to recover it.<ref name="SWTOR" />

At the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Sith Inquisitor]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]]&mdash;the future Darth Nox&mdash;traveled to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in order to claim their inheritance. Their ancestor's lightsaber was normally kept by [[Mila Escalus]], the last of the Escalus line, but had been stolen by mobster [[Gyl Rosen]]. The new Lord Kallig then battled Rosen and retrieved their lightsaber. With this weapon, Kallig confronted [[Darth Zash]] in their [[Duel in the Dark Temple|final showdown]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Depending on the advanced class of the player, the lightsaber may be a single-bladed weapon or a double-bladed saber.
